purpose: Fix the Gate 0A replicate count R at the FIXED primary margin 0.005 using the same decision procedure Gate 0A will use. No real genotype; no biological claim.

decision_procedure_mirrored_from_gate_0A.statistic: paired difference Delta_r = R2_genetic(A) - R2_genetic(B) per replicate
decision_procedure_mirrored_from_gate_0A.decision: declare positive headroom iff CI lower bound > 0 (one-sided positive)

margins.rule: the detectability gate NEVER chooses the margin from results; it only fixes R at the fixed 0.005

grids.sigma_axis_note: sigma is the replicate-to-replicate SD of the paired R2_genetic difference (trait-architecture + estimation noise). It is a PLANNING AXIS, not known until a real panel is bound; a small real-panel pilot pins sigma and reads off R.

detectability_criterion.false_positive_guard: report P(declare positive | Delta = 0) at every R; the one-sided operational FPR of a calibrated 95% CI is ~0.025
detectability_criterion.underpowered_action: if no gridded R reaches 0.90 power at the pinned sigma, increase R; NEVER lower the 0.005 margin

frozen_output_table_structure.summary: min R reaching >=0.90 power at the primary 0.005 margin, per sigma
frozen_output_table_structure.note: the STRUCTURE is frozen here; the numbers are produced by the run

does_not_authorize: using this R as formal Gate 0A evidence
promoting R without a real-panel sigma pilot
